name: Agency
overview: The Scriptures reveal that agency is a God-ordained principle evident in both salvation and judgment. In Genesis 3:15, God declares His sovereign plan to bring enmity between the serpent and the woman's seed, showing divine initiative in salvation history. Similarly, in 1 Samuel 15, the LORD commands Saul through Samuel to execute judgment against Amalek, demonstrating that God uses human agents to carry out His righteous decrees. These passages affirm that while God is sovereign, He entrusts individuals with the responsibility to act according to His will in both redeeming and judging purposes.
